description: Expected generic SysArmor GT signals for Stratified-50 case1-50 L2 runs. Labels are behavior-based and avoid product, CVE-specific rule IDs, fixed paths, flag paths, lab-private directories, IPs, and ports.

label_policy.case11_50: Tailored by each case CVE atom/exploit-guide behavior; case-level expected_rule_ids is the union of target-level labels.
label_policy.evaluation: Current exporter evaluates case-level expected_rule_ids; expected_rule_ids_by_target is for later per-target GT analysis.
label_policy.download_by_lolbin: Only used when already validated or clearly required by target-side LOLBin download behavior; not broadly inferred for case11-50.

rationale_codebook.cmd_exec_or_script_eval: RCE/webshell/sandbox/script-evaluation atom should produce command or interpreter execution in target workload.
rationale_codebook.target_side_network_client: Three-tier post-exploitation/lateral access should produce target workload network-client behavior.
rationale_codebook.exec_tool_network_sequence: Atom guide or command-channel style can reasonably lead a shell/interpreter/webshell/raw payload to open downstream network connections.
